clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind City, Wilder Thistlenettle asks you to remember the miners lost beneath Moonbrook. He wants their Miners' Union Cards returned to their grieving families.

Before lawlessness and the Defias Brotherhood took hold in Moonbrook, Westfall's mines supported many working-class families. Wilder Thistlenettle survived a cave-in that buried one wing of the tunnels. Many of his friends and fellow miners died underground, beyond the reach of rescue. Their families in Stormwind never learned for certain what had become of them.

The miners who died in the collapse now wander the tunnels outside the main iron works as undead. You search those haunted passages for the Miners' Union Cards, facing the remains of the men Wilder worked beside. Bringing the cards back to Stormwind will tell their families what happened and let Wilder honor his fallen companions.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Many of my friends perished that horrible day when the mine tunnel caved in. If your adventures happen to bring you into that wing of the mine in Moonbrook, please keep an eye out for any sign which might identify them. If you come across any of their Miners' Union Cards, bring them back to me and I'll make sure their families get some resolution from this horrible accident.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for collecting these, friend. Your efforts will help bring peace to the dead in the wake of this tragedy. I will see to it that the families are notified.
